    border-radius: 999px;

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
   CRO redesign May 2026 — PDP "Build Your Matching Set" flow
   ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

   Scope: anything inside .product__info-container--matching-set, i.e.
   only products tagged / collected as matching-set / mommy-and-me /
   daddy-and-me / family-matching. Non-matching-set products keep their
   Dawn-default presentation.

   Goals (from CRO spec):
   ─ Single primary CTA      (hide the standalone Add-to-Cart submit)
   ─ Family-member cards     (pills + qty stepper + remove)
   ─ Progressive disclosure  (+ Add Dad / + Add Baby chips)
   ─ Live summary            (count, total, savings) above the CTA
   ─ Compact trust row       (under the CTA, not below the fold)
   ─ Collapse measurement /
     Purchase Confidence     (so first viewport is cards + CTA)
   ─ Compress vertical
     spacing ~40–60%
   ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

/* Make sure the matching-set block paints — historically it ships
   hidden until JS unhides; on matching-set products we want it
   prominently visible. */
.product__info-container--matching-set .product-desktop-ux {
  display: block;
}

.product__info-container--matching-set .product-matching-set__role-price,
.product__info-container--matching-set .product-matching-set__card-price,
.product__info-container--matching-set .product-matching-set__card-price--header {
  display: none !important;
}

/* 1. Single primary CTA + single source of size truth.
   On matching-set products the standalone Add-to-Cart submit + its
   dynamic checkout button are hidden so the matching-set CTA below
   reads as the only primary path. Customers buying a single piece
   simply leave one card visible. The main variant-selects is also
   hidden — sizing happens per-family-member-card, not via the
   standalone size picker, so showing both creates two competing
   size selectors. Hiding only the picker UI; the underlying
   variant-selects element still receives change events from the
   bundle so anything downstream of it (e.g. price/url sync) keeps
   working. */
.product__info-container--matching-set .product-form__submit,
.product__info-container--matching-set .product-form__buttons {
  display: none !important;
}
.product__info-container--matching-set .product-form__dynamic-checkout {
  display: none !important;
}
/* On bundle products hide the legacy variant pickers that are now
   handled per-family-member-card inside the bundle:
   • SIZE — discriminator: aria-describedby="size-conversion-message"
     emitted only on size fieldset / size <select> by the Liquid template.
   • COLOR — discriminator: .product-form__input--swatch or
     .product-form__input--color-image (color picker variants in Dawn).
   Per-card axis pickers cover both. Type (Shirt/Dress) stays visible
   above the bundle because it's a role-discriminator that re-seeds
   the default-visible family members (handled by JS reactivity). */
.product__info-container--matching-set variant-selects > fieldset[aria-describedby="size-conversion-message"],
.product__info-container--matching-set variant-selects > .product-form__input:has([aria-describedby="size-conversion-message"]),
.product__info-container--matching-set variant-selects > fieldset.product-form__input--swatch,
.product__info-container--matching-set variant-selects > fieldset.product-form__input--color-image,
.product__info-container--matching-set variant-selects > .product-form__input--swatch,
.product__info-container--matching-set variant-selects > .product-form__input--color-image {
  display: none !important;
}

/* When Type perfectly partitions roles (data-type-implicit attribute
   set by initMatchingSetBuilder via detectImplicitTypeMapping), the
   global Type picker is redundant — each role's natural Type is
   implied. Hide every remaining option group; the JS will still keep
   it in the DOM so any underlying form data stays consistent. The
   ::variant-selects element itself still emits change events which
   the bundle ignores in implicit mode. */
.product__info-container--matching-set[data-type-implicit="true"] variant-selects > .product-form__input,
.product__info-container--matching-set[data-type-implicit="true"] variant-selects > fieldset.product-form__input,
.product__info-container--matching-set[data-type-implicit="true"] variant-selects > .product-form__step-heading {
  display: none !important;
}
/* Hide the step-mini-headings too (they were "1. CHOOSE SIZE / 2. PICK
   COLOR" numbering that no longer makes sense once size is removed). */
.product__info-container--matching-set variant-selects > .product-form__step-heading {
  display: none !important;
}
/* Hide the legacy size-guide subtree (snapshot, conversion message,
   chart wrapper). The matching-size-guide details element stays in
   the DOM with [hidden] so the per-card "Find {role}'s fit" link can
   still un-hide it via the shared trigger handler. */
.product__info-container--matching-set variant-selects > #size-conversion-message,
.product__info-container--matching-set variant-selects > .matching-size-guide__snapshot,
.product__info-container--matching-set variant-selects > .size-chart-wrapper {
